messages:
jon: Heads-up: post-deploy smoke run flagged sustained 5xxs on the embed route in apac2 during the first 4m.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2026-03-23-canary -> canary pools. Postdeploy probes kicked off (ci: 4823334444).
emily: Seen the spike too. 5xx is mostly 502 gateway from proxy, payloads show short lived timeouts to embed-worker.
infra-ops: pulling logs and qps: `kubectl logs -l app=embed-worker -n apac2 --tail=200`
infra-ops: sample from pod embed-worker-7f9: `ERROR: upstream response timeout after 15s` repeated 12x in 3m.
maya: Could be warmup/slot exhaustion on the new variant. Any memory OOMs?
infra-ops: No OOMs in dmesg. We do see high connection churn and a bunch of `accept4: too many open files` in kernel logs on host gke-apac2-12.
jon: Ok let's be conservative: hold the global rollout, pin apac2 to previous stable variant, and demote canary in apac2.
deploy-bot: Routing change initiated. To pin apac2:
```
POST /api/v1/route/pin
{"region":"apac2","model_variant":"v2026-03-20"}
```
(deploy-bot): response 200.
deploy-bot: Canary demoted in apac2; traffic pinned to v2026-03-20. Synthetic re-run scheduled (500 seeds).
emily: After pin, 5xx rate dropped to baseline within two synthetic rounds. p95 embed latency back to normal.
sam: Decision: keep apac2 pinned for 30m, then re-run a focused canary with reduced qps and instrumented tracing. Do not proceed with global promote until cleared.
maya: Filing runtime ticket RT-6348: investigate descriptor leak + accept4 errors, cc infra@ and networking@.
jon: Also add a line to release notes: "apac2 pinned to v2026-03-20 while we investigate transient embed-worker connection churn; no user-facing rollback required."
emily: Will update release notes and the release channel.
infra-ops: We'll run an infra health sweep: file descriptors, ulimit, and sidecar conn settings. Posting quick checks in 10m.
sam: Thanks team. If the focused canary fails again we'll plan a rollback of the canary tag and schedule a change window follow-up tomorrow. :earlier_than_expected_clock:
